name: FLUX.3 Klein — text to image
title: Make a picture, slower but finer
summary: Write a detailed description — and, if you like, draw boxes where things go — and get a photo-quality picture. Its twin, "Make a picture in seconds", does the same much faster; pick this slower one for a little more detail and variety.
description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 Image Klein base model (50 steps at guidance 3.5 — slower than the distilled card, for a little more detail and variety; Black Forest Labs position the base build for fine-tuning and recommend the distilled one for everyday generation). Write full sentences: subject, action, setting, light, style; put any text to render in "quotes". FLUX.3 is trained on long, detailed captions. Its AI improver (a Qwen 3.5 model that writes that caption for you) fails on this ComfyUI build with "Unsupported Flash Attention tensor strides", so leave it off and write the caption yourself: the medium first, then the scene, the light, the camera, and where each subject sits. To place things, draw boxes in the layout and cite them as <obj_1>, <obj_2>… in the prompt. Experimental.
author: Template - ComfyUI (FLUX.3 Image Klein)

exposedParameters.label: Prompt
exposedParameters.default: close up profile of a young male athlete with closed eyes pressing his sweaty forehead against a soccer ball, right hand gripping the ball, stark white background, athletic jacket, white ball with jagged red graphic patterns, high contrast studio lighting, highly detailed skin texture, sharp focus Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.
